corrections.fix: Niels notes that a Morgan Stanley note initiating Lehman at overweight on 30 June was reiterated on 14 July and 27 August, shortly before the September failure; the hosts treat it as an ironic anecdote, with no explicit methodological conclusion.

corrections.issue: The 50-60% of typical risk is Rob's own stated risk level (said in C05, 'equivalent numbers to you really'); Niels did not state a risk level in the transcript.

completeness_estimate: 0.85 - first reader (80 claims) captured nearly all of the methodological content (sizing, FX conversion, window length, investor returns); misses are supporting data points, a few reasoning links, and one hosts' view on bond risk premia.
